exam_facts.test: Evidence of L5-S1 disc herniation impinging on the adjacent nerve root.

exam_facts.result: Normal spine curvature, no visible swelling.
Tenderness localized to the lower lumbar spine.
Intact to light touch and pin-prick throughout the leg and foot.
WBC 5.8 × 10⁹/L, neutrophils 62%, lymphocytes 28%, hemoglobin 13.4 g/dL, platelets 245 × 10⁹/L
Na⁺ 140 mmol/L, K⁺ 4.2 mmol/L, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, eGFR >90 mL/min/1.73m², glucose 88 mg/dL, ALT 19 U/L, AST 21 U/L, total calcium 9.5 mg/dL

exam_facts.test: Prothrombin time (PT) and activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT)

exam_facts.result: Color: pale yellow; clarity: clear; pH 6.0; specific gravity 1.015; no leukocyte esterase, nitrites, blood, protein, or glucose; 0–1 WBC/hpf, 0 RBC/hpf, no casts
Uterus anteverted, homogeneous myometrium, endometrial stripe 6 mm; bilateral ovaries normal in size and echotexture; no adnexal masses, free fluid, or hydronephrosis
Liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen, and kidneys sonographically normal; no retroperitoneal mass or abscess; no hydronephrosis or ureteral dilation

exam_facts.test: Lumbar spine radiograph (AP and lateral views)
exam_facts.result: Normal vertebral alignment and disc height at L5-S1; no spondylolisthesis, fracture, or destructive bone lesion

exam_facts.test: Lumbar spine MRI with and without contrast
exam_facts.result: At L5-S1: left paracentral disc herniation measuring 6 mm craniocaudal × 5 mm anteroposterior × 7 mm transverse, extending into the left lateral recess and abutting the left S1 nerve root; no cord compression, no cauda equina effacement, no epidural enhancement or abnormal signal to suggest infection or tumor; adjacent vertebral bodies and posterior elements unremarkable
